rows.text: "Welcome to the Cogito Hair Salon of the Mechanical City!" Charon ties up their hair and taps twice on the bar table with their knuckles. "We can adjust 'Intra-Cognition' here. You can become whatever you want to be, no?"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Oh, look at that mechanical lady next to you. They can teach you how to improve up your charisma or intelligence. It's all up to your choices."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Adjust Intra-Cognition — Understand the rules of improving Intelligence

"Let me teach you a thing or two. In actuality, intelligence is nothing but logic derived from absolute *experience*. I think people nowadays overestimate reason. When you have absolute *experience*, you'll be able to go beyond the limits of the self."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I've already forgotten my *self*. Soon, I'll ascend to become a god!" Screwllita declares proudly as they fix their hair, as fragments of planets turn into glittering diamonds on their ears. They are ready to soar into the sky.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Adjust Intra-Cognition — Understand the rules of improving Charm

"Let me teach you a thing or two. I think charisma is all about making things simple. The simpler you are and the more you do things your way, the more charismatic you'll be. When you exhibit absolute *indifference*, you'll be able to do beyond the limits of the self."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I've already forgotten my *self*. Soon, I'll ascend to become a god!" Screwllita declares proudly as they fix their hair, as fragments of planets turn into glittering diamonds on their ears. They are ready to soar into the sky.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Soon, their hair is done. They then fly away before your eyes.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "It's a mechanical bug trapped in *egoism*." Charon puts away their scissors and says despondently. "You should forget about them. Some of the gems they collected were left behind and gifted to the Hair Salon. You can pick one as a keepsake."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Choose 1 pair of machine flower underpants.
